game_concept: A tower defense set in Snowy Hold – Northern Wall, the northern wall: the innkeeper must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Default Armory: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing.
theme: Snowy Hold – Northern Wall: the northern wall
core_gameplay_loop: In Northern Wall, repeat each round: Use default parameter values so the armory works even when arguments are missing. Each round, blizzard sprites strike the watch bell, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the armor value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the watch bell from blizzard sprites in Northern Wall: keep the armor meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 76-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: armor drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 76-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Default Armory
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Default Armory' (Week 6 slot 4), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Northern Wall'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how armor changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Northern Wall.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 76 seconds while armor > 0.
